rows.en:
"I see. Thank you..."
{a} is breaking into a smile.
He looks like he's fondly remembering something...
"What are you looking at?"
Oh, it's a photo.
What's this...?{p}

"No, you can't. This is a very precious photo..."
Oh, he put it away.
Senpai, who on earth are those people...?
"Taguchi. Come back to the club room the day after tomorrow.
I'll round up seven people who know all about the school's seven wonders..."
"...{a}."
"Well, let's head home.
I'm counting on you, the day after tomorrow."
"......"{p}

No.
You can't get away from this.
This project can't happen without you.
Got it?
You'd better come, no matter what.
Or else...{p}

"Eeeeeek!☆"
{a}...
Stop tickling meee!☆
"Ahahaha...☆"
N-no, stop!
What is this squirmy thing?
It feels like I'm being tickled by a mop of fuzzy strings...
"S-stop it, please!"
"Heh heh heh.
I'll let you off if you take on the seven wonders project........."
Ahahahaha... ...... ...... ...... ...... ...... ......{p}

Honestly, {a}!
Tickling people like that is just mean.
But what on earth was that fuzzy thing?
A foxtail, maybe?
It felt like some kind of feelers.
And I think I saw something like an ammonite, too...
No, I must have imagined it.
Still, he really is a weird guy.
Ugh, what am I going to do?
It looks like I'm being forced into the seven wonders project.
He says I have to do the interviews the day after tomorrow.
{a} was all breezy about it, saying he'd set everything up for me, but...
What a drag.{p}

What did you say?
That won't do.
This is an order from your senior.
You have to do the interviews.
I'll round up seven people who know all about the school's seven wonders.
Right, let's make it the day after tomorrow.
Come back to the club room the day after tomorrow, got it?
"......{a}."{p}

He's so pushy.
He must really want to get this project through.
What a pain...
......{p}

I think he's an interesting person.
Or, to put it another way...
Kind of lovely, I guess?
Apparently, when he was a first-year, he was a total scaredy-cat.
Isn't that cute?
Actually, he's been on my mind lately.
My eyes keep following {a} around.
Somehow I feel like I just can't leave him alone.
You could say he tickles my maternal instinct.
Hee hee...{p}

I think he's a mysterious person.
Like, it seems nothing could ever faze him.
...Well, maybe things do faze him.
More like he bounces back fast.
Like he'd come back to life even if he died.
Oh, right, I hear that when {a} does Kokkuri-san, he uses a 500-yen coin.
That way, he can summon a genuine high-level spirit as Kokkuri-san.
Maybe I'll ask him to do it for me.
I'll bring a 500-yen coin with me.
Okay, I'd better get going, or I'll be late for our appointment.{p}

...The hallway seems kind of dim.
It isn't even that late.
Maybe it's because it's cloudy outside?
This school has its own creepy atmosphere, but on days like this I feel it even more strongly.
There are so many incidents and accidents here that nobody can explain.
And they say the second gym that's almost finished is being built right where a mountain of human bones turned up...
Still, was this hallway always this long?
I'm not getting anywhere at all.
...Huh?★
Someone's sitting on the floor over there.
It looks like a girl, but...{p}What should I do? Should I call out to her?
Call out to her
Ignore her

I decided to ignore her after all.
She just didn't seem like a normal person.
She was... how do I put it?
I feel like she was giving off something, a sinister aura, a ghostly aura, whatever you call it.
She must have been a ghost or something.{p}

...Phew, I finally made it to the stairs.
But why are the first-year classrooms on the top floor, anyway?
Every morning I'm nearly late, and I'm sick of it.
Late...!
Oh nooo, it's already past the time we agreed on.
I have to hurry.{p}

Ah, I can finally see the club room.
Standing in front of it... who's that girl?
I've never seen her before.
Someone who wants to join?
Or was she called here by a senior, like me?
Oh, now that I look closer, she's not in uniform.
Huh, so she's not a student.
"Excuse me, you there?"
All of a sudden, she spoke to me.
"Y-yes?"
I answered without thinking.
I hate to admit it, but she's prettier than me.{p}

"Do you know someone named Shinji Kondo?"
Shinji Kondo...?
I've never heard that name before.
"No, I don't."
"I see. Where on earth could he be?
And he's my destined one..."
Saying that, the woman wandered unsteadily away.
Her destined one, huh? How romantic.
Hee hee, she even had a red thread wound around her little finger.
So even grown-ups believe in that stuff.{p}
I opened the door cheerfully.{p}
And all at once, fourteen eyes turned toward me.{p}

Seven people, boys and girls, are sitting around the big table in the middle of the club room.
They're all staring at me, looking startled.
Except for {a}, they're all complete strangers.
I was so sure Senpai would be the only one here...
"Um, you must be the seventh one.
Please, have a seat over here."
Geez, {a} is being so formal, acting like this is the first time we've ever met.
Anyway, what are these people doing here?
"Um, {a}-senpai.
What did you need me for?
And what do you mean, the seventh one...?"
"Huh? Um, 'senpai'...?"
{a} is looking at me with a puzzled frown.
Those are really the eyes of someone looking at a stranger.{p}

"Well, {a}, you're a sly one.
Going and getting yourself a cute girlfriend like this."{p}

"Did you hear that?
She called him 'senpai.'"{p}

"Which means she's his junior from middle school.
Let's have a look... Well, well, isn't she quite the cutie?
All right, as a special favor, I'll tell your fortune with Kokkuri-san.
Don't worry, the Kokkuri-san I summon is a high-level spirit."{p}
"That's so mean, {a}! Keeping it a secret even from me, your best friend!"{p}

"Hmm. So you're {a}'s girlfriend?
How unremarkable."{p}

"Hey, hey, where did you two meet?
How did you start going out?"{p}

The other six seem to have mistaken me for Senpai's girlfriend.
They're all teasing us at once.
"Everyone, hold on a minute!"
Senpai stood up from his seat and shouted the six of them down.{p}

So cool..........
I think I might fall for him.
"Hey, you."
"Y-yes!"
No, no, this is no time to be swooning.
"Sorry, but I think you've got the wrong person.
I am {a}, sure, but I don't know anyone like you. And besides, I'm still only a first-year. I can't think of any reason anyone would call me 'senpai.'"{p}

Whaaaaaaaaat?!★
That's impossible...
Now that I think about it, Senpai... does look a teeeeny bit younger...
Is this back when Senpai was a first-year?
Did I slip back in time or something?★
Eeek, how cool! It's just like a movie!{p}

But if I tell them that, will they even believe me?
Even if this is the past, it would make me sad to have {a} look at me like I'm weird.
"Could you be someone Hino knows?
Seeing as you're wearing the uniform, you seem to be a student here..."{p}Now what do I do?
How should I answer?
Say I came from the future
Just nod along

"Yes, yes, that's right, actually.
Um, I was told to come here... and to have a little fun with you all."{p}

Hee hee, looks like I fooled them nicely.
Still, I don't get this 'seventh one' business.
Seventh in what order?
"Well then, please tell us the last story.
Everyone's been waiting, so they won't be satisfied with just any ordinary scary story."
Scary story...?
Then this must be the seven wonders gathering I've heard rumors about.
So they really held one at this school, too.
And Senpai is involved in it...
He really is a mysterious person.
But is it really okay for me to be doing this?
Will I actually be able to get back to my own world?
With those thoughts in my head, I began to speak.
"Well then, this is something that happened to me just now..."{p}
And so began the seventh story, one that by rights should never have been told...{p}

Actually, I'm in love with him.
...You know, here's what I think.
In this world, there are people who rule and people who are ruled.
{a} is one of the people who rule.
And I don't mean he just looks that way because he's bossy.
{a} is the best.
He knows all kinds of stories.
Scary stories about our school.
And then there's his face when he tells those stories.
It's so mysterious, it just gets me.
Some people say that face scares them and they hate it.
But I don't care. I love him.
If it were Senpai, I'd love to be ruled.
...Just kidding.
But, gosh, I'm getting nervous.{p}

"Um, is something wrong?"
I called out to her.
Somehow I just can't leave people alone.
It looked like the girl had been crying.
When I spoke to her, she peered up at me through the gaps in the hands covering her face, two big, goggling eyes staring out.
And then,
"...Huh. Just a girl..."
She spat out just those words, then faded away without a sound.
W-what kind of attitude was that?!☆
I wasn't scared so much as furious.
The first ghost I've ever seen in my life, and it's like this? That really ticks me off.
That's it, I'm taking it out on {a}!{p}

Here I am at the newspaper club.
"Excuse meee!"{p}
Oops, I opened the door without even knocking.{p}

"No, that's not it. The truth is, I came from the future...!"
It's a really sudden thing to say, but I'm sure {a} will believe me.{p}"Uh-huh, uh-huh, and then?"
Oh, how mean! Senpai doesn't believe me one bit.
Insist I came from the future
Smooth it over somehow

"I really did come from the future, I'm telling you!"
"...I see. Then how about telling us a little about this future of yours?
Did a world war break out?
What about the ozone hole?
Have you ever traveled in space?"{p}

"In the time I come from, they're about to finish building the second gym.
There used to be an old school building there, right?
I heard that when they tore that old school building down, they found lots of human bones."
Everyone suddenly went quiet.
Looks like they finally believe me.
"...Okay, thank you very much.
With that, we have our seven stories, so I'd like to bring this meeting to a close."
Huh? That's it?{p}

Ahh, everyone's leaving.
"Um, it was Taguchi, right?
Thanks for your trouble. You can go home now."
With that, {a} left too.
"If you don't hurry out, I'll lock up."
Waaah, that's easy for you to say...
How on earth am I supposed to get back to my own time?!★{p}

"Oh, come on, you guys can't take a joke at all!
And here I was, put in charge of scaring you all, ah ha, ah ha ha ha ha..."{p}
Was that a bit of a stretch?{p}

"Stop making fun of me already!
You know I can't stand stories like that, and you're trying to scare me anyway, aren't you?
I didn't know you were such a mean person, Senpai.
Goodbye.
Please pretend everything I said earlier never happened."{p}

With that, I ran out of the club room.
Senpai was so shocked he couldn't say a thing.
I mean, it's Senpai's fault.
He went and brought up the devil's phone...{p}

He made me think he'd seen through what I really am!
I finally found just my type, and I missed my chance to take his soul.
Oh well, it can't be helped.
I'll go back to hell for now and rework my plan.
I won't fail next time.{p}

Heh heh heh, but this means a student named Mayumi Taguchi will vanish from the school.
I wonder if he'll feel even a little responsible?
It was a weird school, but it was a nice place where the work came easy...
Maybe they'll even have a new mystery: the schoolgirl who vanished.
Heh heh heh, I think I'll come back to play someday.{p}

"All right.
If it'll save my life, I'll join you."
"Heh. That's the right attitude.
Then let's have a little welcome party."
With that, {a} took some orange juice out of the club room's fridge.
Wait, isn't that fridge supposed to be for storing film?
Honestly, he's hopeless.
And where does he even buy orange juice in a mini plastic bottle instead of a can?
Senpai took two glasses down from the shelf and split the orange juice between them.
"Cheers!"
Raising his glass high, Senpai is smiling.{p}

Ugh, come to think of it, it was orange juice.
Now my mouth is all sickly sweet.
Same goes for Senpai, I bet.
We got a little carried away by the mood.
"...So, Taguchi, what kind of person is the one you want to kill?"{p}

"You want to know?
The absolute worst.
Gloomy, twisted, quick to think everyone's out to get him, and on top of that, he thinks he's a genius."
"Wow, sounds like a real piece of work.
We can't let someone like that go on living.
All right, I'll help too.
It's for my cute junior."{p}

Heh heh heh. Deep down, he's not someone who could ever really be a villain.
Poor Senpai.
"I'm so happy to hear you say that, Senpai."
"No need to thank me. Didn't I tell you?
It's for my cute junior. So, what's the creep's name?"{p}

"Wha...☆
Urgh......gah......"
There really are all sorts of things hidden in here. It surprised me.
Who'd have thought there'd even be poison?{p}

Hee hee hee. Don't worry, Senpai.
I'll take over properly after you're gone.
That's my big brother's wish, too...
Taguchi is my mother's maiden name.
My parents got divorced two years ago, you see.
Until then, my last name was Hino.
You never noticed at all, did you?
I'll do a splendid job as the third president of the Murder Club.
Hee hee hee... Now, who should my next target be?{p}
